kill_results: no scenario admitted in rounds 1 and 2
a construction gain of at least 2 pp whose read CI90 includes 0, or a transfer ratio below 0.25

evaluation.reward_metric: per-row slot_f1_exact_f1 (strict entity F1, exact type+filler match) -- the metric KC-S1b was admitted on, the least gameable of the per-row metrics, and not a term in the official SLU-F1's own arithmetic
evaluation.stage_one: rails.evolution.select_per_target on fold A, per scenario, gates saves >= 4 / harms <= 2 / net >= 3 on that scenario's own 60 rows -- saves and net are absolute counts and the harm half is the owner's RATE of 1 per 30 paired rows, floored at 1, from the single loop-config field harms_per_rows. Winner = largest net, then fewer harms, then fewer artifact bytes, then lowest k. A COUNT rule: at 60 rows an interval is still uninformative on a sparse metric, and a reviewer can recount the gate by hand from harms_allowed, n and harms, which every stage-one outcome records. The V2 draw IS the answer to the power question: scaling KC-S1b's measured per-stratum saves to 60 rows clears the gate in EIGHT of eighteen scenarios against three of eighteen at 30 rows, audited in docs/checks/speech-aware-evidence-acquisition/2026-09-06-slurp-evo-stage-one-power/power.json. transport clears at both fold sizes under the rate; it would have been refused at 60 under an absolute one-row bound, which is exactly the scale-dependence the rate removes.
evaluation.stage_two: rails.evolution.confirm_assembly on fold B, with the background bound REPLACED by the per-scenario harm bound of coordinator decision 3 (2026-09-06): the pooled TARGETED CI90 lower bound strictly above 0, every ADMITTED scenario at harms minus saves <= 2 rows on its own 60 fold-B rows (the same 1-per-30 rate stage one uses, from the same field, so the two stages cannot report two definitions of one word), and the NON-ADMITTED scenarios pooled at no worse than -1.0 pp. Accepted as a whole, never partially

hypothesis: H1: shown only its own incumbent block and eight construction utterances of a scenario with their gold entities, the frozen core can rewrite the per-intent slot schema so that per-row strict entity F1 rises on rows it has never seen, and a best-of-K selection over four rounds produces a schema whose gain survives one read on DEV against the SEALED KC-S1b rows. H2: the shares-only control (the incumbent blocks with every filler list deleted) is the content floor, and the token-matched form twin is the form floor. Both controls are deterministic and cost no contact.

SLURP-EVO-EXEMPLARS-V2.note: 24 entity-bearing utterances per scenario against M = 8 in seventeen of eighteen scenarios, so the three per-round draws differ in membership as well as order -- unlike EVO-A1, where twelve tools have a pool of exactly M. audio is capped at 22 by capacity: the folds are drawn first and keep their full 60 per scenario, and only 22 entity-bearing utterances remain in audio afterwards. 22 is still 2.75 x M and above the floor of 16; the cap is recorded in the roster receipt's exemplar_quota_policy block.
